# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 9 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 63 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 2 tokens; Sizing — 1 token; Duration — 6 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the dusk theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #fdfaf3);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="day" or "dawn" or "night" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--paper, #fdfaf3);   /* the day theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #fdfaf3;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dusk | day | dawn | night | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #fdfaf3 | #fdfaf3 | #fdfaf3 | #e7e4d6 | 主纸笺不透明底；夜晚只压暗纸色。 |
| `--paper-note` | #f8f3e4 | #f8f3e4 | #f8f3e4 | #e7e4d6 | 天气批注纸底。 |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 400 12px/1.65 "Xiaolai", sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-sl-caption12);
font-family: var(--font-hand);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `sl-caption13` | `.sl-caption13`, `--text-sl-caption13` | 13px / 1.65 | 400 | `hand` | 天气批注标签与帮助 |

| `sl-score124` | `.sl-score124`, `--text-sl-score124` | 124px / 1, letter-spacing -5px | 400 | `hand` | 桌面主分数上限；实际按卡片宽度 clamp(76px,22cqw,124px) |
| `sl-score99` | `.sl-score99`, `--text-sl-score99` | 99px / 1, letter-spacing -5px | 400 | `hand` | 手机主分数上限；实际按卡片宽度 clamp(68px,23cqw,99px) |

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hand` | `--font-hand` | `"Xiaolai", sans-serif` |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/Xiaolai-Regular.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Xiaolai-Regular.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Xiaolai-Regular.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (read the file: a path is in this system’s directory, an id is its `_blobs/<id>.<ext>`), copy it beside your page or import it as an asset (`artifact.mjs upload`, where your tool lists that) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Xiaolai | `fonts/Xiaolai-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-hand)` | `xiaolai` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-4);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-4` | 4px | 已认可纸面布局使用的 4px 间距；不强制抹平其他源稿精确值。 |
